ex2.s: You stir the soup slowly and don't let it boil, or the chicken will become hard and dry.
a: Stir the soup slowly and don't let it boil, or the chicken will become hard and dry.
e: Công thức dùng câu mệnh lệnh: bỏ “You”, bắt đầu bằng động từ “Stir”.
Recipes use imperatives: drop “You” and start with the verb “Stir”.

ex2.s: Đầu tiên, đun sôi nước. Sau đó cho mì vào và nấu thêm ba phút.
a: First, boil the water. Then add the noodles and cook them for three more minutes.
First, boil the water. Then put the noodles in and cook for another three minutes.
First, boil some water. Then add the noodles and cook for three more minutes.
e: Câu mệnh lệnh + từ nối First/Then. “three more minutes / another three minutes” = thêm ba phút.
Imperatives + First/Then. “three more minutes / another three minutes” = three extra minutes.

ex2.s: Đừng cho quá nhiều đường vào cà phê của bố tôi, vì ông ấy không được ăn đồ ngọt.
a: Don't put too much sugar in my dad's coffee, because he can't eat sweet things.
Don't put too much sugar in my father's coffee because he isn't allowed to eat sweet food.
Don't add too much sugar to my dad's coffee, because he mustn't eat sweet things.
e: Mệnh lệnh phủ định: Don't + V. sugar không đếm được → too much (không phải too many).
Negative imperative: Don't + verb. sugar is uncountable → too much (not too many).

ex2.s: When the water|starts to boil,|add the chicken|and cook it|for twenty minutes|with the lid on
m: Khi nước bắt đầu sôi, cho gà vào và nấu trong hai mươi phút, đậy nắp.
When the water starts to boil, add the chicken and cook it for twenty minutes with the lid on.
e: Mệnh đề “When …” chỉ thời điểm, sau đó là câu mệnh lệnh. “with the lid on” = đậy nắp.
A “When …” clause gives the time, then the imperative. “with the lid on” = covered.
f: When the water starts to boil

q: Viết công thức khoảng 80 từ cho một món ăn Việt Nam đơn giản: nguyên liệu (có số lượng) và 4–5 bước.
Write a recipe (about 80 words) for a simple Vietnamese dish: ingredients with amounts and 4–5 steps.
ex2.m:
Tomato egg soup (for three people)
You need: two tomatoes, two eggs, a spring onion, a litre of water, a spoon of fish sauce and a little salt.
First, cut the tomatoes into small pieces. Then fry them in a little oil for two minutes. After that, add the water and boil it. When the water is boiling, pour in the eggs slowly and stir gently. Finally, add the fish sauce, salt and chopped spring onion. Serve hot with rice.
e: Cần có: danh sách nguyên liệu với a little/some/a cup of …; 4–5 câu mệnh lệnh; từ nối First, Then, After that, Finally; ít nhất một câu với When/until.
Include: an ingredient list with a little/some/a cup of …; 4–5 imperatives; sequencers First, Then, After that, Finally; at least one When/until sentence.

t: Bài đọc: Cuối tuần ở Đà Lạt
Reading: A weekend in Da Lat

rd.tx: Last weekend, Nam and his friends went to Da Lat by bus. The trip took seven hours, so they arrived late on Friday night. On Saturday morning it was cold and foggy. They visited a flower farm and took a lot of photos. In the afternoon they rented bikes and rode around Xuan Huong Lake. The food was cheaper than in Ho Chi Minh City, and Nam ate too much grilled corn. On Sunday it rained, so they stayed in a small coffee shop for three hours. Nam says it was the best trip of the year.
rd.tr: Cuối tuần trước, Nam và các bạn đi Đà Lạt bằng xe khách. Chuyến đi mất bảy tiếng nên họ đến nơi muộn vào tối thứ Sáu. Sáng thứ Bảy trời lạnh và có sương mù. Họ thăm một vườn hoa và chụp rất nhiều ảnh. Buổi chiều họ thuê xe đạp và đạp quanh hồ Xuân Hương. Đồ ăn rẻ hơn ở TP.HCM, và Nam ăn quá nhiều ngô nướng. Chủ nhật trời mưa nên họ ngồi ba tiếng trong một quán cà phê nhỏ. Nam nói đó là chuyến đi tuyệt nhất trong năm.

ex: How did they travel to Da Lat?
Sáng thứ Bảy thời tiết thế nào?
What was the weather like on Saturday morning?
Chiều thứ Bảy họ làm gì?
What did they do on Saturday afternoon?
thuê xe đạp đi quanh hồ
rented bikes and rode around the lake
Vì sao họ ngồi quán cà phê ba tiếng?
Why did they stay in a coffee shop for three hours?
The food was ___ than in Ho Chi Minh City.

warm.s: The trip to Da Lat took seven hours by bus, so Nam and his friends arrived late on Friday night.
q: Họ đến Đà Lạt khi nào?
When did they arrive in Da Lat?
e: “arrived late on Friday night” – vì chuyến xe mất bảy tiếng (“took seven hours”).
“arrived late on Friday night” – because the bus trip “took seven hours”.

warm.s: On Sunday it rained, so they stayed in a small coffee shop for three hours.
e: “rained”, “stayed” là động từ có quy tắc, đuôi -ed đọc /d/. “for three hours” chỉ khoảng thời gian.
“rained” and “stayed” are regular; -ed sounds like /d/. “for three hours” gives a duration.
f: stayed in a small coffee shop

warm.s: The food in Da Lat was cheaper than in Ho Chi Minh City, and it was delicious.
e: Nhấn “cheaper” và “delicious”; “than” đọc nhẹ /ðən/.
Stress “cheaper” and “delicious”; say “than” weakly as /ðən/.

ex2.s: On Saturday afternoon, Nam and his friends ___ bikes and rode around Xuan Huong Lake.
e: Câu kể chuyện quá khứ, và động từ sau “and” là “rode” (quá khứ) → “rented”.
It is a past story, and the next verb is “rode” (past) → “rented”.

ex2.s: Nam says the weekend in Da Lat was the ___ trip of the year, even though it rained on Sunday. (good)
a: best
e: good → better → the best. Có “the … of the year” nên dùng so sánh nhất.
good → better → the best. “the … of the year” needs the superlative.

ex2.s: On Saturday morning it was cold and foggy, but they visit a flower farm and took a lot of photos.
a: On Saturday morning it was cold and foggy, but they visited a flower farm and took a lot of photos.
On Saturday morning it was cold and foggy but they visited a flower farm and took a lot of photos.
e: Mọi hành động đều ở quá khứ (“was”, “took”) nên “visit” phải là “visited”. Đừng trộn hiện tại vào câu kể quá khứ.
All the actions are past (“was”, “took”), so “visit” must be “visited”. Don't mix tenses in a past story.

ex2.s: Đà Lạt lạnh hơn Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh nhiều, nên chúng tôi đã mang theo áo khoác ấm.
a: Da Lat is much colder than Ho Chi Minh City, so we brought warm jackets.
Da Lat is much colder than Ho Chi Minh City, so we brought warm jackets with us.
Da Lat is much colder than Ho Chi Minh City, so we took warm jackets.
Da Lat is much colder than Ho Chi Minh City, so we took warm jackets with us.
Da Lat is much colder than Ho Chi Minh City, so we brought warm coats.
Da Lat is much colder than Ho Chi Minh City, so we took warm coats with us.
e: “lạnh hơn nhiều” = “much colder than”. “đã mang theo” → quá khứ: bring → brought, take → took (bất quy tắc).
“much colder than” for a big difference. “brought / took” are irregular past forms.

q: Viết lại câu thành kế hoạch tương lai với “be going to”, thay “Last weekend” bằng “Next weekend”
Rewrite as a future plan with “be going to”, replacing “Last weekend” with “Next weekend”
ex2.s: Last weekend Nam and his friends went to Da Lat by bus.
a: Next weekend Nam and his friends are going to go to Da Lat by bus.
Next weekend Nam and his friends are going to Da Lat by bus.
Nam and his friends are going to go to Da Lat by bus next weekend.
Next weekend, Nam and his friends are going to go to Da Lat by bus.
e: Kế hoạch tương lai: “are going to + go”. “Nam and his friends” số nhiều → “are”. Có thể rút gọn “going to go to” thành “going to”.
Future plan: “are going to + go”. The plural subject takes “are”. “going to go to” can be shortened to “going to”.

ex2.s: Nam|ate too much|grilled corn|because the food|was much cheaper|than in|Ho Chi Minh City
m: Nam ăn quá nhiều ngô nướng vì đồ ăn rẻ hơn ở Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh nhiều.
Nam ate too much grilled corn because the food was much cheaper than in Ho Chi Minh City.
e: “eat” → “ate” (bất quy tắc). “corn” không đếm được nên dùng “too much”, không dùng “too many”.
“eat” → “ate” (irregular). “corn” is uncountable, so “too much”, not “too many”.
